name: bench-subagent-fanout
description: Bench workload: the soak-background-agents shape, BOUNDED. Three async local_agent subagents are launched, each streams four passes of text + tool_use + tool_result + task_progress into its own card, then each reports task_updated{status:completed} FOLLOWED BY its task_notification, the parent summarises, and the turn ends with `result`. Both terminal signals are required, and in that order: task_updated only stashes the host-side exit, and the completion sibling that ends a launch's running state is written when the notification (or a TaskOutput drain) arrives. Measures the subagent card tree, the tray counters and the per-agent activity runs under concurrent background traffic. Tool and message ids carry both ${TURN} and ${ITER} so nothing collides across passes or across repeated turns. Run it with `ao-harness bench subagent-fanout`.
